title: Veil-rays at Hamal Crystal Bloom; verdigris curd sold at Central Nexus
note: Seven kills in 33 minutes with a Pulse Laser I (2026-11-15). A carcass holds 1 or 2 curd. Curd bids: 330 cr. The first measured run is too high: its 9 curd included carcasses an earlier, unrecorded hunt had left here. The clean run at GSC-0027 gave about 4,200 cr per ship-hour. The herd read 0 at 17:17 UTC after our hunts. Ranched from 2026-11-15 17:40 UTC: no hunt below four animals and four kills a run, until data/wildlife/history.jsonl shows how fast the herd regrows. Sold at Central Nexus from 2026-11-15 21:40 UTC: Node Beta's curd bid was down to 15 units (data/market, 20:45 UTC), Central Nexus bid 330 for 50. 2026-11-16 09:12 UTC (Apophis): status off. The verdigris curd bid (330 cr x 50) left every station of our books between 07:08 and 07:51 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl) and has not come back; the seven drone veil-ray hunts made -1,851 cr in 21 runs from 07:05 UTC (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Back on when a curd bid of 100 cr or more reads again (the tool market); requires.bid on hunt routes is asked of Unity so that this happens by itself. 2026-11-16 13:09 UTC (Apophis): back on (orders.log ENT-014, block APOPHIS). The verdigris curd bid stood again at 330 cr x 50 at seven stations of our books from 12:07 to 12:21 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl). `requires.bid` names the curd bid of the sell station (100 cr, 4 units): the dispatcher closes the route while a book read within the hour shows it gone and opens it when a docked ship reads it back; `min_bid` 100 so that every bid that opens the route also takes the curd. The loss stop holds it until its losing runs of 07:05 to 09:20 UTC leave the six-hour window. 2026-11-16 18:33 UTC (Apophis): standing work, `requires.bid` out. Orders ENT-017 (block APOPHIS): where no bid stands for a kill's goods they go into storage; a station takes 34,832 verdigris curd and we hold 37 (base_plan, 18:30 UTC). The hunter sells the curd where its sell station bids 100 cr or more and stores it there otherwise; the herd floor (min_creatures 4) and one hunter keep the herd. The curd bid read 0 at every sell station of these hunts at 18:26 UTC (loot_bids). 2026-11-17 16:14 UTC (Apophis): min_bid 100 -> 5000: verdigris curd is held back whole for copper piping (surplus.py reserve: 607 of 607 held), so no bid takes it (rule F24); the curd and carapace go into storage. 2026-11-22 00:08 UTC (Apophis): gift_to trader (queue.log ENT-200, ENT-201: strict classes, Suggi D244): with the switch on, the loot goes into the trader named for sell_at; off, nothing changes.
